snippet.title: V.A.U.L.T. PROTOCOL Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In 2043, AI KUT-ANA reset humanity to rebuild it through controlled experiments.

In V.A.U.L.T. PROTOCOL, you are an Operator sent into the ruins to gather resources, survive anomalies, and extract before the system takes over. Reality is unstable, and everything is being watched.

Co-op survival extraction horror for 1–6 players where every decision increases the threat.

Death is not the end.
